displayName: OCI-DB-MY-002: MySQL — Root Account Remote Login
description:
Detects remote login attempts to MySQL root account from non-localhost

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_db_my_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%mysql%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%root%') AND "value" > 0
